author: mwongj
release_notes: Speeds up large first-time syncs, preserving stable 1.21.2 behavior. Fetching a missing series episode list built a new Xtream client per series, which logged in again before every request: two paced requests per series. The login result is now reused per account credentials, so each fetch is one request at the same spacing, roughly doubling the rate. Every call still carries credentials and the cached login is dropped after any failure. Includes the 1.21.2 fix for slow per-episode inventory lookups. Covered by regression tests; 498 tests pass. Existing settings, plugin identity and prior release packages are preserved.
